_comment: SLA Engine Configuration — edit thresholds here without touching code

LOW.text: Continue standard processing and routine monitoring. No immediate SLA intervention is currently required.

MEDIUM.text: Review the affected workload within the defined processing window and prioritize unresolved anomalies before they accumulate into a processing backlog.

HIGH.text: Prioritize the affected records for resolution and assign them to the appropriate operations queue to reduce the risk of processing delays and potential SLA breach.

CRITICAL.text: Immediately escalate the affected workload, prioritize critical anomalies, and allocate additional operational resources to prevent an SLA breach.
